Soft diffuse daylight, muted greens, weathered white and beige, calm.

forest-mountains.prompt: The edge of a forest where the trees thin out: a few last pines and birches frame the foreground, and beyond a slope of scrub, boulders and scree rises a wall of high, jagged, impassable grey mountains, their snow-dusted peaks fading into an overcast sky. clearing.prompt: A small clearing on a well-marked forest path that crosses the image from left to right, extending east and west into the trees. canyon-view.prompt: A breathtaking panorama from the rim of the west wall of a great canyon. rocky-ledge.prompt: Standing on a narrow rocky ledge about halfway up the wall of a deep river canyon. Hazy daylight from the strip of grey sky above, ochre and grey rock, blue-green water, vertiginous mood.

canyon-bottom.prompt: At the bottom of a river canyon, beneath towering ochre and grey rock walls rough enough to climb. end-of-rainbow.prompt: A small, narrow rocky beach on the bank of a wide river just below a huge waterfall, hemmed in by tall gleaming white cliffs. aragain-falls--rainbow.prompt: At the top of an enormous waterfall where a broad river plunges about 450 feet into a misty gorge, seen from the rocky north bank, wet boulders and the end of a narrow path framing the foreground. temple.prompt: The north end of a vast ancient temple of pale stone, seen at a slight upward angle, lit by the viewer's lantern and a soft golden glow that seems to emanate from the stone itself. On the east wall, a large panel of weathered relief carvings, an ancient prayer worn into abstract patterns eroded beyond legibility; beneath it a staircase leads down into darkness. The west wall is solid granite. To the north, the exit passes between huge fluted marble pillars. Pale stone, gold leaf accents, deep shadows, sacred mystery.

altar.prompt: The south end of a vast ancient temple of pale stone and marble, lit by the viewer's lantern and a soft golden glow. Directly ahead stands a massive carved stone altar, bare, its edges trimmed with tarnished gold ornaments. In one corner of the floor, a small dark hole drops into blackness. Tall pillars and arches recede into shadow on either side. Pale stone, gold, deep shadows, solemn and sacred.

dam.prompt: Standing on top of a massive old concrete flood control dam spanning a vast underground cavern, once a tourist attraction, long abandoned. A walkway with an iron railing stretches along the crest. Behind the dam lies a wide dark reservoir; the sluice gates are closed and water spills over the top in a glistening sheet. In the foreground stands a control panel with a large metal bolt, above which a small green plastic bubble glows serenely. Paths lead north, south and west; a rough scramble leads down. Lit by the viewer's lantern. Deep blue-greens, grey concrete, rust.

dam--open.prompt: Standing on top of a massive old concrete flood control dam spanning a vast underground cavern, long abandoned. A walkway with an iron railing runs along the crest. The sluice gates are wide open: torrents of white foaming water roar through them and thunder downstream in clouds of spray, while the reservoir behind drops. In the foreground, a control panel with a large metal bolt and a small glowing green plastic bubble. Paths lead north, south and west; a scramble leads down. Lit by the viewer's lantern. Blue-greens, white foam, grey concrete, rust.

dam-lobby.prompt: The old waiting room for tours of a flood control dam, deep underground and long deserted, lit by a single flickering ceiling lamp and the viewer's lantern. Rows of worn wooden benches, a dusty reception counter, faded framed pictures of the dam, peeling institutional paint. Open doorways lead north and east into staff areas; another opening leads south onto a path over the top of the dam. Beige, faded green, grey and rust, nostalgic and eerie.

maintenance-room.prompt: The ransacked maintenance room of an old flood control dam, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. On the wall ahead, a metal panel holds four large buttons colored blue, yellow, brown and red. Pipes and gauges run along the concrete walls, emptied metal tool chests stand with their lids open, and loose wires dangle where equipment was ripped out. Doorways lead west and south. Grey concrete, rust and oily blacks, with the four colored buttons standing out.

dam-base.prompt: At the base of a massive concrete dam that looms above and to the north, filling the upper part of the image and rising into the gloom of a vast cavern. A cold, dark river flows past in the foreground. Along its shores rise towering white cliffs, giant pale walls stretching north to south as the river winds downstream. Pale grey light filters in from downstream, plus the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. Blue-green water, chalk-white cliffs, grey concrete, imposing.

river.prompt: Low viewpoint just above the surface of a wide, quiet river flowing through a deep gorge under a narrow strip of pale overcast sky. Tall chalk-white cliffs loom along the east bank; large boulders line the west shore, with a narrow beach below the cliffs and a small landing further along. The river curves out of sight ahead, and a faint mist hangs far downstream. Soft diffuse light, reflections on the calm water. Deep blue-greens, chalk white, grey rock, serene.

river-rapids.prompt: Low viewpoint just above the surface of a wide river running faster here, the water roughening into white-capped rapids between the walls of a deep gorge. Ahead, mist rises and the roar of rushing water grows. On the east shore stretches a sandy beach with a large landing area; a small patch of beach lies below the white cliffs on the west. Soft diffuse light from a strip of grey sky, spray glittering. Deep blue-greens, white foam, chalk cliffs, tense and urgent.

white-cliffs.prompt: A narrow strip of rocky beach running along the base of towering white cliffs, beside a dark flowing river. The chalky pale cliff face rises sheer above, streaked with grey and ochre. A narrow path follows the shore along the cliffs, and a tight dark passage leads into the cliffs themselves. Pebbles, bleached driftwood, damp rocks at the waterline. Soft diffuse light from a strip of grey sky far above. Chalk white, blue-green water, grey stone, lonely.

shore.prompt: The east shore of a swift river at the bottom of a deep gorge, where the water churns treacherously over hidden rocks. A path runs from north to south along the bank, its south end quickly turning around a sharp corner of rock. Wet stones, eddies and foam at the waterline, steep rocky walls behind. Soft diffuse light from a strip of grey sky far above. Blue-greens, white foam, grey and ochre rock, wary mood.

sandy-beach.prompt: A large sandy beach on the east shore of a river that flows quickly by, at the bottom of a deep gorge. Smooth pale sand with wind ripples and small dunes, bleached driftwood, scattered pebbles. A path runs south beside the river, and to the northeast the dark mouth of a passage is partially buried in drifting sand. Soft diffuse light from a strip of grey sky above. Sandy ochre, blue-green water, grey rock, quiet and open.

sandy-cave.prompt: A small cave filled with soft sand, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. Drifts and dunes of pale sand slope up against the rough rock walls and cover the whole floor, rippled by old currents, deep enough to dig in. The only exit is an opening to the southwest, through which a faint grey light seeps. Sandy ochre, browns, grey rock, hushed and secretive.

mine-entrance.prompt: The entrance of an abandoned coal mine deep underground, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. In the west wall a shaft framed by heavy old timber props opens into blackness, with rusted rails disappearing inside. Another exit leads off at the south end of the room. Coal dust, soot-blackened walls, broken planks nailed across a support. Coal blacks, rust, dark browns, foreboding.

squeaky-room.prompt: A small, rough underground room lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. A dark passage at the north end seems to rustle with faint squeaky sounds, and pale streaks of droppings stain the floor near it. Another exit leads east. Rough rock walls with soot and mineral streaks, a low ceiling. Coal-dark rock, rust and dark browns, uneasy and watchful.

bat-room.prompt: A small underground room with dark doorways only to the east and south, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. The rough ceiling is pitted with roosting crevices and hanging stalactites, and pale guano streaks the walls and floor. Stale, heavy air, dust drifting in the light, the rocky floor uneven and slippery. Coal blacks, rust and dark browns, creepy and cramped.

shaft-room.prompt: A large underground room in an old coal mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. In the middle, a small square shaft drops through the floor into darkness. Constructed over it is a sturdy riveted metal framework with a pulley, from which a heavy iron chain hangs, holding a large basket suspended above the opening. Exits lead west and north. Coal-black walls, rust and iron greys, industrial and gloomy.

smelly-room.prompt: A small nondescript room deep in a mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. A small staircase descends into darkness, and a faint sickly greenish-yellow haze seems to rise from it, carrying a foul odor. To the south a narrow tunnel opens. Rough sooty walls, coal dust on the floor. Coal blacks, rust and sickly green tints, unpleasant.

gas-room.prompt: A small room in a coal mine reeking of coal gas, lit by the steady warm glow of the viewer's lantern. A faint yellowish haze hangs in the air, softening the far walls. A short flight of stairs climbs up, and a narrow tunnel leads east. Sooty walls with glistening black coal seams, scattered rubble. Coal blacks, rust, sickly yellow-green, quietly dangerous.

coal-mine.prompt: A nondescript tunnel in an old coal mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. Low ceiling braced with old timber props and crossbeams, glistening black coal seams in the walls, passages branching off into darkness in several directions, all looking alike. Rubble, coal dust and puddles on the floor. Coal blacks, rust and dark browns, oppressive and disorienting.

ladder-top.prompt: A very small room in an old mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. In the corner, the top of a rickety wooden ladder leads down through a hole in the floor into darkness, its rungs worn and uneven. A rough staircase cut into the rock leads upward on the other side. Coal-black walls, rust, dark browns, cramped and precarious.

ladder-bottom.prompt: A rather wide room deep in a coal mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. On one side, a narrow, rickety wooden ladder descends from a dark hole in the ceiling. Passages leave the room to the west and south. Timber props, black coal seams, gravel and coal dust on the floor. Coal blacks, rust and dark browns, gloomy.

mine-dead-end.prompt: A dead end in an old coal mine: the narrow tunnel ends in a rough wall of black coal and rock, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern, the light pooling on the glistening seam ahead. Pick marks scar the wall, an old timber frame braces the ceiling, coal dust covers the floor. Coal blacks, rust and dark browns, airless and final.

timber-room.prompt: A long, narrow mine passage cluttered with broken timbers: collapsed props and splintered beams lie across the floor and lean against the walls, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. A wide passage comes from the east and, at the west end of the room, turns into a very narrow passageway, from which a strong draft blows, stirring the coal dust. Coal blacks, rust, splintered wood browns, precarious.

drafty-room.prompt: A small, drafty room at the bottom of a long vertical shaft, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. A heavy iron chain hangs down the shaft from darkness far above. A passageway leads south, and a very narrow passage opens to the east. Coal dust swirls in the draft. Rough black walls, rusted iron fittings. Coal blacks, rust, iron greys, cold and gloomy.

machine-room.prompt: A large, cold room deep in a mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern, its sole exit to the north. In one corner stands a strange machine reminiscent of an old clothes dryer: a riveted metal cabinet with a large round lid on its front, closed, and a tiny switch on its face. Pipes, bolts and a little frost on the walls. Iron greys, rust, coal black, cold blue shadows, curious.

slide-room.prompt: A small chamber that was once part of a coal mine, lit by the warm glow of the viewer's lantern. The south wall is a smooth slab of grey granite. A long passage leads off to the east, a small opening to the north, and a steep, polished metal slide twists downward into darkness through the floor. Coal dust, timber props, rusty fittings. Coal blacks, rust and grey granite, inviting and risky.
